Class SimpleBoard

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.game.board.SimpleBoard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Board
public class SimpleBoard extends Object implements Board
Represents the logical grid of the Tetris game. This class manages the board matrix, active brick movement, collision detection, and row clearing operations.
